Portuguese gas network charges on top of the PVB/MIBGAS hub price paid by PT power plants: UGS parcela I 0.71 EUR/MWh (Quadro 3-13; the parcel applicable to centrais em regime ordinario) + annual firm entry+exit URT capacity at full utilization ~0.39 EUR/MWh (Quadros 3-17/3-18; entry at the Sines LNG terminal or the VIP Iberico, similar order). PT CCGTs are supplied predominantly via the Sines LNG terminal, whose regasification/terminal-use tariff is deliberately NOT counted, keeping the premium a conservative lower bound. Gas-year 2025-26 values applied to both data years.

Lower over higher heating value of natural gas (MITECO: 'Para el paso de PCS (poder calorifico superior) a PCI, en el gas natural se utiliza el factor de conversion de 0,901'). Gas is traded per MWh on higher heating value (Spanish gas system rule PD-01, sec. 6.2; Regulation (EU) 2015/703, art. 13); plant efficiencies and emission factors are on lower heating value (Danish Energy Agency technology catalog; IPCC 2006).
